message.content:
This is a part of a headset (headphones with or without microphone), classified in 8518. Parts of headphones fall under 8518.90. The HTSUS subheading 8518.90 covers parts of the goods in 8518, and its statistical suffix is 8518.90.80 ("Other"). The 8518.90 tariff lines are 8518.90.20 (parts of the goods of 8518.10, 8518.30, and others?), 8518.90.40, and 8518.90.80.

I recall the structure as 8518.90.20 (of loudspeakers, nonspecific), 8518.90.40 (of 8518.30 or similar), and 8518.90.80 (other). I am not certain of these, but the final line is "Other," so 8518.90.80 is the best fit. The statistical suffix would be 8518.90.8000 for the 10-digit code.

CBP rulings on headset ear cups (e.g., for Lightspeed) have classified them under 8518.90.8000.

{"hts_code": "8518.90.8000", "reason": "The plastic ear cup is a part suitable for use solely with an aviation headset (headphones) of heading 8518, so it falls under the 'parts' subheading 8518.90, other."}
